result.summary: Found 3 issues, including one major text overlap bug and two minor layout/cropping issues.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time and delivery fee text appear overlapping/garbled ('25-3€0min delivery')
issues.suggestion: Fix text rendering logic to properly space and separate delivery time and delivery fee values, e.g. '25-30 min · €0 delivery'

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the edge of the screen, showing only partial content
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or add peek indication/scroll cue so users know more content is available via horizontal scroll

issues.description: Category filter row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge, suggesting more categories exist but no visual scroll indicator is shown
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or scroll arrow to indicate horizontal scrollability
